text:
Google says one sign of a quality website is other well-known websites linking to you or mentioning you.

For a local business, that means real places that know you exist. The footy club you sponsor. Your suppliers. The local chamber of commerce.

Ask each one for a link to your website this month.

Someone in Innaloo searches "brake repairs" and gets different results to someone in Rockingham.

Google looks at where the person searching is standing.

So name the suburbs you actually work in on your website. Osborne Park. Innaloo. Stirling.

Give Google something to match.

Sunday night. You write next week's to-do list. 23 items.

Cross off 20.

Keep the three that bring in work. Reply to every enquiry the same day. Ask every happy customer for a review. Make sure your hours on Google are right.

The other 20 can wait.
